part.text:
Implemented the fix in `lib/adapters/http.js:363`: when `maxBodyLength` is unlimited (`-1`), the adapter now passes `Infinity` to `follow-redirects` instead of letting its 10MB default apply.

Validated:
- `should properly support default max body length (follow-redirects as well)` passes
- `should support max body length` passes
- ESLint passes

The two failures in the full HTTP suite are pre-existing/environmental (isolated test interference and HTTPS network timeout); the max-content test passes when run alone.
